storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP Pinterest Downloader makes it easy to save videos, images, and post text from Pinterest.com to your computer.

How it works: Browse any page on Pinterest and click the extension icon. The extension scans visible pins and shows you all available videos, images, and text posts in organized tabs. Download individual items or use "Download Visible" to save everything at once.

It handles Pinterest's HLS video streaming, CDN image delivery, and dynamic content automatically — no external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required. Media saves directly to your Downloads folder in an organized Pinterest Downloader subfolder.

Key features:
- Download videos, images, and text from any Pinterest page
- Bulk "Download Visible" saves all pins on the current page
- Multi-source video detection — DOM, inline data, PinResource API, thumbnail derivation
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Overlay buttons appear next to Pinterest's Save button on each pin
- Tabbed popup showing Videos, Images, and Text Posts with counts
- Rescan button to detect newly loaded pins after scrolling
- Auto-saves to organized Pinterest Downloader subfolder
- Pinterest-themed dark UI with red accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to Pinterest.com and browse any page
3. Click the extension icon to see detected media
4. Select items or click "Download Visible" — saved to your Downloads folder

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a video from Pinterest?
faq.answer: Go to any Pinterest page and click the extension icon. The popup shows all detected videos in the Videos tab. Click download on the one you want, or use "Download Visible" to save all of them.

faq.question: Can I download images too?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension detects videos, images, and text posts. Switch to the Images tab in the popup to see and download all detected images.

faq.question: What about text posts?
faq.answer: Text from visible pins is extracted and available in the Text tab. Text posts are saved as .txt files with the post URL and timestamp included.

faq.question: What quality are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: The extension automatically selects the best available quality. It checks multiple sources — PinResource API, inline data, DOM elements — and picks the highest-resolution progressive MP4 available.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player. HLS streams are automatically converted to MP4 in your browser.

faq.question: Where are my downloads saved?
faq.answer: Files save to a Pinterest Downloader subfolder inside your browser's default Downloads directory, organized by source.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Can I download from boards and profiles?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension works on any Pinterest page — home feed, boards, profiles, search results, and individual pin pages.

faq.question: Why isn't the extension finding any media?
faq.answer: Make sure you are on a Pinterest.com page. Pins must be visible (loaded) on the page. Try scrolling to load more content, then click the Rescan button in the popup.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.
